Welcome Message 
Thank you for attending the Texas Our Little Miss State Beauty Competition. 
We are honored to have you here and hope your time with us is filled with 
joy, meaningful connections, and lasting memories. 
Welcome to our family! 
I would also like to extend a heartfelt thank you to my Co-Director, Julie 
Nice, for her commitment, partnership, and support in helping bring this 
program to life. 
We would like to take a moment to recognize those who have played an 
integral role in making this event possible. First, my sincere gratitude goes to 
our outstanding Texas royalty and their families. It is a privilege to serve as 
your Texas State Directors, and your continued support, dedication, and 
trust are truly appreciated. 
A special thank you to our families for their unwavering support, 
encouragement, and countless contributions behind the scenes. Your belief 
in this journey and your willingness to be part of it mean more than words 
can express. 
Additionally, I would like to recognize our local directors for their 
exceptional leadership and dedication. Your hard work in guiding 
contestants and supporting families has been invaluable, and this event 
would not be possible without your efforts. 
Finally, thank you to each of you for placing your trust in us and allowing us 
the opportunity to welcome you into the Our Little Miss community. 
Our motto, “One Team, One Dream,” reflects our commitment to supporting 
you every step of the way—through this competition and beyond, all the 
way to the World Pageant. 
We look forward to a successful season and many more to come. 
Julie Nice & Angela Kyle
Texas State Directors

state.

My sweet Finley Kay,
As we look back on your year as 
queen, I hope you know just how 
proud I am of you and how much 
you have accomplished. You have 
had such a special year, and 
watching you grow, shine, and 
represent your title has been 
nothing short of amazing.
Being a queen is about so much 
more than wearing a crown and 
sash. It is about the memories 
you make, the people you meet, 
the kindness you show, and the 
way you carry yourself wherever 
you go.
Throughout your reign, you have 
represented your title beautifully, 
and you have given me so many 
reasons to smile and be proud. 
You may still be little, but you 
have grown so much. While you 
may not remember every picture, 
every appearance, every little 
Finley Pence
2025 Texas’ Universal Beauty 0-2
smile, or every moment, these are memories I will treasure forever.
This year has been about so much more than a pageant. It has been about 
watching you experience new things, grow, and make memories that will stay 
with me long after your crown is put away. You have had the opportunity to 
experience things that many little girls only dream of, and I am so thankful for 
every single moment of this journey.
Finley Kay, you have done such a wonderful job representing your title, and I 
could not be prouder of my little queen. You have made this year so special. I 
hope that one day, when you are older, you can look back at all these pictures 
and memories and see just how loved, supported, and celebrated you have 
always been.
I love you more than words could ever explain. You will always be one of my 
greatest blessings, and no matter where life takes you, I will forever be your 
biggest supporter.
I love you,
Mama

Texas’ Universal Beauty 3–6 Queen!

As your reign comes to an end, we are definitely sad to say goodbye to 
this special chapter. But more than anything, we are grateful. Grateful

Brynlee, always remember that the crown may come off, but the queen

cannot wait to see where your next adventure takes you.
Once a queen, always a queen.
We love you more than you’ll ever know,
Mom & Dad

My sweet Kennedy,
It’s hard to believe that the time has 
come for your Our Little Miss Texas 
Universal Beauty reign to come to an 
end. It feels like just yesterday we 
were getting ready for you to begin 
this journey, and now somehow this 
chapter is already coming to a close.
Being your mom has given me so 
many moments that I will treasure 
forever, and watching you wear this 
crown has been one of them. I have 
loved watching you grow in 
confidence, step onto stages, 
perform your piano, put together 
your outfits, make your goodie bags, 
and put your own little touch on 
every part of this experience.
You have always had a love for 
beauty, makeup, hair, fashion, and
all the little details that make something beautiful. But this year has reminded me 
that beauty is so much more than what we see on the outside. It’s confidence, 
kindness, courage, creativity, and being proud of the person you are becoming.
I hope when you look back at this year, you remember so much more than the 
crown. Remember the excitement of
getting ready, the dresses, the sparkles, the music, the road trips, the laughs, the 
nerves before walking on stage, and all the little moments that only you and I will 
truly understand.
And remember how proud I was of you through all of it.
Your reign may be coming to an end, but the memories you made and the 
confidence you gained will always be a part of you. You will always be my Our 
Little Miss Texas’ Universal girl, and I will always be grateful that I got to 
experience this chapter right beside you.
And now, as you close this chapter, you are also stepping into such an exciting time 
in your life. Your senior year is here, graduation is getting closer, and there are so 
many new adventures waiting for you.
I hope you never forget that you don’t need a crown to shine.
You are my daughter first, and that will always be my greatest title.
I am so proud of the beautiful young woman you are becoming, Kennedy. Thank 
you for letting me be there for every dress, every picture, every pageant, every 
happy moment, and even the stressful ones. I wouldn’t trade a single part of this 
journey with you.
I love you more than you will ever know. Forever your biggest cheerleader,  MOM

Dakota Fambrough, 
Your dad and I cannot put into 
words how incredibly proud we 
are of you. No one would have 
ever guessed that our “Tank,” our 
all-around athlete, would one day 
compete in a beauty pageant and 
become a beautiful State Queen
—but you did it! And you did it 
while walking through one of the 
toughest seasons of your life. 
Watching you find the strength, 
courage, and confidence to keep 
going has made us even more 
proud of the woman you have 
become.
I have absolutely loved taking this 
journey with you—being your 
Dakota Fambrough

travel companion, your hairstylist, your biggest cheerleader, and, 
if I’m being honest, your therapist too! These memories are ones 
I will treasure forever.We love you more than words could ever 
say, and we couldn’t be prouder to call you our daughter. 
Love Mom
